name: Yamagami Toma
source:
A former genius surgeon detective searching for a place to die.

A sufferer of chuunibyou who calls himself the dark clown.

Maybe he smokes to shorten his remaining life...?

Apparently when he gets drunk he reverts to his true self and speaks in Kansai dialect.
[From [url=https://and-zero.com/characters/toma]Official site[/url]]
